ValidationRule.description: It will not allow to edit A-Z Review after 14 days onwards.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', NOT(ISNEW()), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_A_Z_Review', OR( ISCHANGED(Borrowing_OFI_Relationship__c), ISCHANGED(Business_Details__c), ISCHANGED(Customer__c), ISCHANGED(Lead__c), ISCHANGED(Opportunity__c), ISCHANGED(Personal_Banking__c), ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(Transaction_Banking__c) ), Completed_Date__c + 14 <= TODAY() )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Record cannot be edited after 14 days from Completion date.
